description.value: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba is a Tokyo-founded chain specializing in mazesoba, a rich, broth-free saucy noodle dish that sparked a mazesoba boom in Japan before expanding to North America. The Surrey location is one of several BC outposts of this internationally growing brand, offering mazesoba, ramen, rice bowls, gyoza, and Japanese soft serve. Cyclists stopping here get a filling, fast Japanese noodle meal with online ordering available for convenience.
